issues.on_page: General Government: Salaries and benefits ... Miscellaneous
issues.issue: The rules give NRDs the natural resources/conservation function. The printed heading is General Government, and these lines are administrative. The extractor split the heading: admin lines general government, project/water lines natural resources/conservation. Defensible, but the function is split inside one printed group.
